summary: The second Tanium correction is real and passes the requested direct and renderer-equivalent checks: three Tier-0 sloped wedge cap volumes, a recessed zigzag floor with 14 retaining walls, a simple emitted-edge-derived primary path with zero Tier-0 or higher-tier escape, a centered 248 by 196 footprint, exact literal hashes, and clean lint. G2 still fails. Fresh renderer-equivalent containment found six unique T-Match Tier-0 exterior vertices outside its primaryPath by 0.866050 to 1.732000 projected units, and the required Tier-0 CableCar catenary exits its primaryPath for part of the quadratic curve by as much as 5.637489 units. Vendy's Tier-2 trolley and CableCar's Tier-2 pod also escape their accepted silhouettes. These results contradict the author report's zero-outside claim and leave the batch short of the primary-silhouette and higher-tier-interior contract.
authority_order: docs/career-world-production/concept-briefs.json and the eight promoted canonical project PNGs

recorded_failures: flattened Kaizen Metrics, Vendy/Tanium, T-Match, CableCar, and XSearch topology

chronology.reason: Tanium still lacked volumetric sloped caps and a recessed trench; slopedWedgeCap remained unused.
Tanium is corrected, but renderer-equivalent checks refute the author report's containment claim for T-Match and CableCar and find Tier-2 silhouette escapes in Vendy and CableCar.

findings.claim: T-Match and CableCar still do not have primaryPath values that contain their complete rendered Tier-0 exterior identity, so the author report's zero-outside result is false.
evidence: The governing contract defines primaryPath as the normalized outer silhouette and requires Tier 0 to contain the complete primary silhouette, all exterior masses, and required connections: docs/career-world-production/briefs/tech-world-composition.md:204-206,220-225. Per-batch acceptance requires a normalized primary path whose Tier 0 matches manifest and selected-panel topology: lines 519-526.

Renderer-equivalent expansion used the actual projectExtrusion implementation for every extrusion face and the literal surface/stroke paths. A high-precision winding-number test found six unique T-Match Tier-0 exterior coordinates outside tmatchPrimaryPath: tmatch-left-lower-step at (-77.9423,-68), tmatch-right-lower-step at (-64.0859,-76), tmatch-left-middle-step at (-61.4878,-80.5), tmatch-right-middle-step at (-45.8993,-89.5), tmatch-left-upper-step at (-45.8993,-92.5), and tmatch-right-upper-step at (-28.5788,-102.5). The first two coordinates are also emitted by tmatch-deep-zigzag-seam-retaining-wall-8, -9, and/or -10. Their nearest silhouette distances are 0.866050 to 1.732000 projected units. Source: features/career-world/definitions/projects-a.ts:1033-1124.

CableCar's required Tier-0 catenary is the quadratic path M -58 -61 Q 0 -48 58 -61 at projects-a.ts:951-956. Sampling the exact quadratic at 4097 evenly spaced parameters found 622 outside samples; the maximum escape is 5.637489 projected units at approximately (14.584961,-54.911025). This is part of the manifest-required bridge identity, not optional decoration.

The author report says its Tier-0 projected-vertex containment check found zero outside vertices at docs/career-world-production/reports/tech-world-composition-g2.json:65-68. That statement is not reproducible. Endpoint-only checking also cannot prove containment of a quadratic stroke between its endpoints.
findings.implication: Two of eight definitions fail the exact outer-silhouette/Tier-0 contract. Literal hashes faithfully bind the defective geometry but do not make it acceptable. G2 cannot be enveloped or admitted to I0.
findings.smallest_correction: Adjust only tmatchPrimaryPath and cablecarPrimaryPath so they remain simple exterior traces and contain the actual renderer-expanded Tier-0 geometry, including the complete CableCar quadratic curve. Recompute only the affected primary/master hashes and report receipts. Do not change the accepted masses, topology, footprint, projection, or placement.
findings.exact_i0_test_requirement: For every definition, expand extrusion faces with projectExtrusion, flatten Q curves adaptively or at a declared subpixel error bound, and require every Tier-0 rendered segment/curve to be inside or on a simple primaryPath. Pin the six current T-Match misses and the CableCar catenary as regression fixtures. A vertex-only endpoint test is insufficient.

findings.claim: Optional higher-tier details escape the accepted primary silhouettes in Vendy and CableCar instead of remaining interior-only.
evidence: The contract limits Tiers 1 and 2 to interior-only detail and requires easter eggs to fit inside the accepted silhouette/footprint contract: docs/career-world-production/briefs/tech-world-composition.md:222-226.
The Tier-2 Vendy trolley at projects-a.ts:564-574 has projected vertex (-10.3923,-84) outside vendyPrimaryPath by 1.141717 units.
All six unique vertices of the Tier-2 CableCar pod at projects-a.ts:963-975 are outside cablecarPrimaryPath; nearest-boundary distances range from 6.124349 to 22.609900 units.
No higher-tier non-stroke primitives exist, but primitive type is not the criterion: hidden strokes still must remain interior and cannot escape the accepted silhouette when made visible.
findings.implication: LOD visibility changes the visible extent outside the accepted primary path, contrary to the tier invariant. This independently prevents exact per-batch acceptance even after blocker 001 is fixed.
findings.smallest_correction: Keep the permitted trolley and pod semantics and move or redraw only those Tier-2 stroke paths inside their accepted silhouettes, or omit the optional details. Do not enlarge footprints or invent new masses to accommodate them.
findings.exact_i0_test_requirement: Run the same renderer-equivalent containment check for every Tier-1 and Tier-2 path, including curve interiors, and fail on any sample outside primaryPath. Pin the Vendy trolley and CableCar pod as regression fixtures.

source_evidence: Three hall extrusions invoke slopedWedgeCap at features/career-world/definitions/projects-a.ts:740-757; the helper emits three fascia surfaces plus one sloped roof per hall, all Tier 0, at lines 303-350.
Recovered roof vertex heights from the actual emitted paths are lower [31,31,44,44], middle [42,42,56,56], and upper [54,54,69,69], proving nonconstant volumetric caps rather than flat-top prisms.
recessedCut is invoked for tanium-zigzag-inspection-trench at projects-a.ts:758. The emitted Tier-0 set contains one recessed floor and 14 retaining walls; helper construction is at lines 181-213.

taniumPrimaryPath at projects-a.ts:672-684 is exactly segment-simple. Renderer-expanded checks found zero Tier-0 points and zero all-tier points outside it. Its 30 vertices lie on actual Tier-0 emitted edges within at most 0.000065 projected units, the four-decimal projection rounding bound; primary and Tier-0 bounds are identical (-192.2576..174.9371 by -130.7846..47).

The centered footprint is 248 by 196 at projects-a.ts:1187-1195. All extrusion plan coordinates fit within +/-124 by +/-98; the forecourt itself reaches x=-124 and y=98, confirming the envelope is centered and not an offset recovery.
Tanium higher-tier details are strokes only and the renderer-equivalent all-tier check found zero silhouette escapes.
Repository ESLint completed with exit 0 and no output. The prior unused slopedWedgeCap warning is gone.

prior_findings_disposition.evidence: Tanium now has the three emitted sloped cap volumes and the recessed floor plus 14 walls described in tanium_final_disposition.
slopedWedgeCap is invoked three times and root ESLint is warning-free.

All eight paths are no longer padded halos and Tanium's new path is an actual emitted-edge trace, but fresh renderer-equivalent containment exposes under-tracing in T-Match and CableCar as blocker 001.
All extrusion plan coordinates fit their centered footprints; Tanium, CableCar, and XSearch retain corrected 248x196, 274.2359x94.2359, and 290x220 envelopes.

Vendy retains a Tier-0 recessed dock at projects-a.ts:530 and Tanium now has the verified recessed trench and sloped halls. The separate Vendy Tier-2 escape is finding 002, not a recurrence of the dock defect.
T-Match retains alternating interlocking Tier-0 steps and a Tier-0 recessed zigzag seam at projects-a.ts:1055-1124, but its primaryPath misses six emitted exterior coordinates as finding 001 records.

CableCar and XSearch retain the required Tier-0 tapered shells at projects-a.ts:935-949 and 1011-1017. CableCar's separate catenary/pod containment defects remain findings 001-002; XSearch passes the fresh renderer-equivalent checks.
Three stepped bars, transfer bay, gate bridge, front gate, and rollback vault remain Tier 0; hashes, simplicity, footprint, and all-tier containment pass.
Five validation chambers, two dissimilar pavilions, raised mezzanine, and stairs remain present; hashes, simplicity, footprint, and all-tier containment pass.

gate_evidence.root_wide_build: PASS via npm.cmd test / vinext build
gate_evidence.root_wide_lint: PASS with zero errors and zero warnings; unused slopedWedgeCap warning is gone
gate_evidence.hash_recomputation: PASS, all eight primaryPath SHA-256 values and all eight serializeCanonicalGeometryPayload SHA-256 values match stored literals
gate_evidence.visual_review: The eight promoted canonical PNGs were inspected as topology references. Tanium's corrected emitted topology now matches its three-wedge/trench identity. No claim of pixel equivalence is made.

i0_required_tests: Recompute primaryPathHash and masterGeometryHash for all 56 definitions from exact UTF-8 payloads.
Require each primaryPath to be an exactly segment-simple closed path without using a tolerance that turns near-adjacent segments into false crossings.
Expand every extrusion with projectExtrusion and require every Tier-0 surface, face, and adaptively flattened curve to lie inside or on primaryPath; pin T-Match's six misses and CableCar's catenary.
Run the same containment check for Tier 1 and Tier 2; pin the Vendy trolley and CableCar pod escapes.
Require every extrusion plan coordinate to fit the centered footprint and separately fixture authored ground-surface plan extrema where surfaces encode the footprint boundary.
Pin Tanium's three sloped roof height vectors, three sets of fascia IDs, one recessed floor, 14 retaining walls, Tier-0 placement, and zero all-tier escape.
Retain independent selected-panel visual sign-off for all eight assets; counts and hashes alone do not prove topology or composition.
limitations: The current repository tests validate F0 contracts and deterministic rendering but do not test primary-silhouette containment, curve interiors, or higher-tier escape; their 15/15 pass does not cover the findings above.
The renderer-equivalent audit evaluates SVG centerlines. A later visual gate should also account for stroke width when checking pixels against an accepted silhouette tolerance.
This review does not accept G2, issue an external envelope, or authorize I0, P0, U0, placement, or integration.
